old_model: single 1756 territorial actor inferred from one colour wash labelled SCHWARTZBURG
problem: No unified Schwarzburg polity existed in 1756. The house had been partitioned since 1599 into Schwarzburg-Rudolstadt and Schwarzburg-Sondershausen, each an imperial principality with its own Ober- and Unterherrschaft, interleaved in the same regions.
historical_evidence: NDB 24 (2010), pp. 12-14 (A. Klinger): 1599 Stadtilm partition; Reichsfuerstenstand 1697 Sondershausen / 1710 Rudolstadt; seat and vote in the Reichsfuerstenrat from 1754. Supported at collection level by Landesarchiv Thueringen holdings, which include joint border inspections by the foresters of BOTH principalities.
territorial_control_impact: The 89 hexes staged from the wash were all UNRESOLVED and carried no controller, so no controller had to be withdrawn. Their provenance moves from a false aggregate polity to an explicitly unpartitioned source region, and the wash geometry is demoted to UNCERTAIN_BOUNDARY so it can never bind again.
notes: The dynastic concept 'House of Schwarzburg' was NOT reused as a structural container: a dynasty is not a territorial polity.

old_model: standalone 1756 territorial actor, with no statement about Saxe-Eisenach
problem: The duke of Saxe-Weimar had also held Saxe-Eisenach since 1741 and was styled Duke of Saxe-Weimar-Eisenach. Left unexamined, that style invites either of two errors: merging the two territories into one polity, or leaving Eisenach out of the scenario altogether.
historical_evidence: Archivportal Thueringen Bestand 26508: Eisenach kept its own Regierung, Kammer and Oberkonsistorium until the 1849/50 reform. Deutsche Biographie sfz39202: Ernst August II Constantin ruled 1748-1758 under the composite style, with a separate administrator in Eisenach during his minority. The 1747 Zollmann sheet names the Duchy of Weimar and the parts of Eisenach separately. Against these, only the BnF cataloguing heading treats them as one entity.
territorial_control_impact: None. Saxe-Weimar held 0 CONTROLLED and 100 UNRESOLVED hexes before this stage and holds the same after: no controller was created or withdrawn. Saxe-Eisenach is registered without geometry, so it controls nothing.
notes: pol_saxe_weimar is NOT superseded - it was correct, only incomplete. The correction adds the missing partner and records the union explicitly.
